regions.full_page: Let me stress here the expression, systems of religion, because if as above defined, religion is a science, there can be but one religion, whereas there may be a thousand different systems. Furthermore, inasmuch as we believe that Jesus was God amongst us and that as God He keeps His promise, "all ages even to the end of time to be with us", as He is with us in the Most Blessed Sacrament; so we must believe too that according to His promise: " ... Thou art Peter and upon this rock I will my Church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it," we must believe that the system of religion which He founded can not possibly go rong. "For the Church cannot err that has God for its guide." And again: "He that heareth you heareth me .... " And stell again: "He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me, scathereth." ** ** *** How disapointing to Jesus! - to professed followers of dis "reforming His Church", instead of following. .... As to that depressed feeling, etc, you complain of or lament, it may be from your age. It seems most women have an experience similar to what you describe, for a time after they are about forty-five. In such cases they usually have to practice quite a little patience - with themselves and with others. At allevents, try and keep up courage and shake off anxiety as much as possible.
